exposure: Vacuum-assisted delivery (VAD) due to non-progressive labor (NPL) in the 2nd stage
outcome: non-progressive labor (NPL) 1st stage in subsequent pregnancy
non-progressive labor (NPL) 2nd stage in subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Singleton pregnancies delivered using vacuum-assisted delivery at a tertiary medical center, with a focus on those due to non-progressive labor in the 2nd stage.
finding: Vacuum-assisted delivery due to non-progressive labor in the 2nd stage results in adverse perinatal outcomes in the index and subsequent pregnancies, and is an independent risk factor for recurrent non-progressive labor in future pregnancies.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted delivery (VAD) due to non-progressive labor in the 2nd stage during an index pregnancy is an independent risk factor for non-progressive labor in both the 1st and 2nd stages during a subsequent pregnancy.
